23800.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of khīrapariyesanā
23800.meaning1: looking for milk; in search of milk

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso khīr'atthiko khīragavesī khīrapariyesanaṃ caramāno gāviṃ taruṇavacchaṃ visāṇato āviñcheyya.

23804.meaning2: (one) made satisfied, drugged with milk, baby
23804.commentary: (SNa) khīramatto vā'ti yathā daharo kumāro uttānaseyyako khīraṃ pivitvā dukūlacumbaṭake nipanno asaññī viya niddāyati, kassaci āyuṃ appaṃ vā dīghaṃ vā'ti na cinteti, evaṃ sappuriso.

examples.text: dīgham'āyu manussānaṃ, na naṃ hīḷe suporiso, careyya khīramatto'va, n'atthi maccussa āgamo'ti.

23805.meaning1: latex-producing tree; tree with milky sap
23805.meaning2: tree with milky sap or fluid
23805.notes: Ayurvedic texts like the Suśruta Saṃhitā and Varāhamihira's Bṛhat Saṃhitā commonly identify a group of five trees. They are nyagrodha (banyan), udumbara (cluster fig), aśvattha (sacred fig), and madhūka (mahua) or pakṣa (white fig).

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khīrarukkho assattho vā nigrodho vā pilakkho vā udumbaro vā daharo taruṇo komārako.

23806.meaningLit: discourse on the tree with milky sap

examples.text: sukkan'ti dasa sukkāni, nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātaṃ takkavaṇṇaṃ dakavaṇṇaṃ telavaṇṇaṃ khīravaṇṇaṃ dadhivaṇṇaṃ sappivaṇṇaṃ.

23810.meaning2: going to milk, dependent on milk

23811.commentary: (MNa) khīr'odakībhūtā'ti yathā khīrañ'ca udakañ'ca aññam'aññaṃ saṃsandati, visuṃ na hoti, ekattaṃ viya upeti, kacci evaṃ sāmaggivasena ekatt'ūpagatacitt'uppādā viharathā'ti pucchati.

examples.text: kacci pana vo, anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathā'ti?

evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanujānissanti samanumaññissanti samanumodissanti tesam'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sā gaddulabaddho daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibaddho. so gacchati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati.
chetvā khīlaṃ chetvā palighaṃ, indakhīlaṃ ūhacca manejā, te caranti suddhā vimalā, cakkhumatā sudantā susunāgā'ti.
aham'etaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmī'ti
diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

23818.meaning1: standing like a post; still as a post
23818.commentary: (ANa) khīlaṭṭhāyī'ti cattāro pāde thambhe viya niccalaṃ ṭhapetvā khīlaṭṭhānasadisena ṭhānena tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā n'eva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tatth'eva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamo assadoso.

23819.synonym: addhā, api, byā, ekantena, ha, have, hi, khalu, kho, kāmaṃ, nissaṃsayaṃ, nissaṃsayena, nuna, nāma, nūna, ssa, sudaṃ, taggha, vata, ve, āma

examples.text: kāmaṃ kāmesu damassu, tāva sunakho'va saṅkhal'ābaddho, kāhinti khu taṃ kāmā, chātā sunakhaṃ'va caṇḍālā.

23821.commentary: (VINa) khujjo'ti yo urassa vā piṭṭhiyā vā passassa vā nikkhantattā khujjasarīro. yassa pana kiñci kiñci aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ īsakaṃ vaṅkaṃ, taṃ pabbājetuṃ vaṭṭati. mahāpuriso eva hi brahm'ujjugatto, avaseso satto akhujjo nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavh'ābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khujjo vā pakkhahato vā na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālā-gandha-vilepanassa seyy'āvasatha-padīpeyyassa. so kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.

23822.commentary: (THIa) idāni tāni sarūpato dassentī udukkhalena musalena, patinā khujjakena cā'ti āha… sāmiko pan'assā khujjo eva.

examples.text: sumuttā sādhumutt'āmhi, tīhi khujjehi muttiyā, udukkhalena musalena, patinā khujjakena ca, mutt'āmhi jātimaraṇā, bhavanetti samūhatā'ti.

23824.meaning1: name of a lay disciple; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost laywoman in great learning
23824.commentary: (ITIa) atha imasmiṃ bhaddakappe amhākaṃ bhagavato kāle sā devalokato cavitvā ghosakaseṭṭhissa gehe dāsiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhi, uttarā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sā jātakāle khujjā ahosī'ti khujj'uttarātv'eva paññāyittha. sā aparabhāge ghosakaseṭṭhinā rañño utenassa sāmāvatiyā dinnakāle tassā paricārikabhāvena dinnā rañño utenassa antepure vasati.

examples.text: dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekaṃ dhītaraṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya, tādisā, ayye, bhavāhi yādisā khujj'uttarā ca upāsikā veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca nandamātā'ti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ khujj'uttarā.
kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.

23826.synonym: aṇu, aṇuka, aṇuparimita, anu, appaka, appamattaka, khuddaka, thoka, parittaka

examples.text: na ca khuddam'ācare kiñci, yena viññū pare upavadeyyuṃ, sukhino'va khemino hontu, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudda-anukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.

23827.synonym: aṇu, aṇuka, aṇuparimita, anu, appamattaka, khudda, thoka
23827.commentary: (MNa) khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādetī'ti khuddake pāṇe vadhaṃ āpādeti. so kira ek'indriyaṃ pāṇaṃ duv'indriyaṃ pāṇan'ti paññapeti.

examples.text: so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto kaṃ vipākaṃ paññapetī'ti?
nisajjaṃ kappeyyā'ti mahallake ghare piṭṭhasaṅghāṭassa hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā nisīdati, āpatti pācittiyassa. khuddake ghare piṭṭhivaṃsaṃ atikkamitvā nisīdati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

23828.meaning2: honey made by a kind of small bees

23831.commentary: (DNa) khuddakanagarake'ti nagarapatirūpake sambādhe khuddakanagarake (DNt) khuddaka-saddo patirūpavācī, ka-saddo app'attho'ti āha khuddakanagarake'ti nagarapatirūpake sambādhe khuddakanagarake'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, mā, bhante, bhagavā imasmiṃ khuddakanagarake ujjaṅgalanagarake sākhānagarake parinibbāyi.

23832.meaning1: Book 5 of the Sutta Piṭaka; Collection of Short Discourses; (comm) all books except the four nikāyas
23832.meaning2: name of a collection of canonical books
23832.commentary: (DNa) katamo khuddakanikāyo? sakalaṃ vinayapiṭakaṃ, abhidhammapiṭakaṃ, khuddakapāṭh'ādayo ca pubbe dassitā pañcadasappabhedā, ṭhapetvā cattāro nikāye avasesaṃ buddhavacanaṃ.

examples.text: sabbam'eva c'etaṃ dīghanikāyo, majjhimanikāyo, saṃyuttanikāyo, aṅg'uttaranikāyo, khuddakanikāyo'ti pañcappabhedaṃ hoti.

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

23837.meaning2: section on minor matters, Khuddakavatthukkhandhaka of the vinyapiṭaka

examples.text: ete'pi hi appicchā'va santuṭṭhā'va subharā'va sallahukavuttino'va. bhagavā pana na y'imaṃ suttaṃ tesaṃ vasena kathesi, aṭṭhaparikkhārikassa vasena kathesi. so hi khuddakavāsiñ'ca sūciñ'ca parissāvane pakkhipitvā pattassa anto ṭhapetvā pattaṃ aṃsakūṭe laggetvā ticīvaraṃ kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ katvā yen'icchakaṃ sukhaṃ pakkamati.
322, 359. tathā dvande pāṇi tūriya yogga sen'aṅga khuddajantukavividhaviruddha visabhāg'atth'ādīnañ'ca.
ḍaṃsā ca makasā ca ḍaṃsamakasaṃ, kuntho ca kipilliko ca kunthakipillikaṃ, kīṭo ca sarīsapo ca kīṭasarīsapaṃ. evaṃ khuddajantuk'atthe.
seyyathā'pi nāma khuddamadhuṃ aneḷakaṃ, evam'assādā ahosi.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma puriso cātummahāpathe khuddamadhuṃ anelakaṃ pīḷeyya. tam'enaṃ mahājanakāyo paccāsīsamānarūpo paccupaṭṭhito assa.

23844.notes: Folk etymology for the origin of sudda, the working class.

examples.text: tesaññ'eva kho, vāseṭṭha, sattānaṃ ye te sattā avasesā te ludd'ācārā khudd'ācārā ahesuṃ. ludd'ācārā khudd'ācārā'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, suddā, suddā tv'eva akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.

23845.meaning1: lesser and minor; small and less important

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudd'ānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.

23846.meaning1: afflicted with hunger and thirst; stricken by hunger and thirst
23846.commentary: (PVa) khuppipāsasamappitā'ti khudāya ca pipāsāya ca abhibhūtā, nirantaraṃ jighacchāpipāsāhi abhibhuyyamānā'ti attho.

examples.text: tañ'hi ete namasseyyuṃ, pūtidehasayā narā, nimuggā kuṇapamh'ete, khuppipāsasamappitā.

23847.commentary: (PVa) khuppipāsasamappitā'ti khudāya ca pipāsāya ca abhibhūtā, nirantaraṃ jighacchāpipāsāhi abhibhuyyamānā'ti attho.

examples.text: sītassa purakkhato uṇhassa purakkhato ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassehi rissamāno khuppipāsāya mīyamāno, ayam'pi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko, dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu.
te khuppipās'ūpagatā parattha, pacchā ciraṃ jhāyare ḍayhamānā, kammāni katvāna dukh'udrāni, anubhonti dukkhaṃ kaṭukapphalāni.

23848.meaning1: distinguished by hunger and thirst, etc.

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhārā-upamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena jivh'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

23854.meaning1: (of a horse) dragging the hoof; (comm) walking on the tip of the hoof in order to not make any sound
23854.meaning2: dragging the hoof, furrowing with the hoof (a trick of horses)
23854.commentary: (MNa) khurakāse'ti agg'aggakhurehi pathavīkamane. rattiṃ okkantakaraṇasmiñ'hi yathā padasaddo na suyyati, tadatthaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne saññaṃ datvā agg'aggakhurehi'y'eva gamanaṃ sikkhāpenti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

23859.meaning2: razor-edged, sharp as a razor; containing razors

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhārā-upamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.

23862.meaning2: edged with razors; with a razor-edged rim

examples.text: khurapariyantena ce'pi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, n'atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, n'atthi pāpassa āgamo.

23863.commentary: (DNt) khurati chindati, khuraṃ vā pāti pivatī'ti khurappo, khuram'assa agge appīyati ṭhapīyatī'ti vā khurappo, saro.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ sallaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yadi vā sallaṃ yadi vā khurappaṃ yadi vā vekaṇḍaṃ yadi vā nārācaṃ yadi vā vacchadantaṃ yadi vā karavīrapattan'ti, aññātam'eva taṃ, mālukyaputta, tena purisena assa, atha so puriso kālaṃ kareyya.

23867.meaning1: shave with a razor; completely bald
23867.commentary: (ANa) dutiye khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā'ti pañca sikhaṇḍake ṭhapetvā khurena muṇḍaṃ karitvā. (THa) saṅghāṭi-khuramuṇḍa-bhikkhabhojī'ti… katasiramuṇḍo

examples.text: aṃ kiṃ maññasi, ambaṭṭha, idha brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ kismiñci'd'eva pakaraṇe khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā bhassapuṭena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājeyyuṃ. apinu so labhetha brāhmaṇesu āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā'ti?
gacchatha, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā
so na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati, hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.

23871.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of khulukhulukāraka
23871.construction:
khulu + khulu + kāraka + aṃ
khulukhulukāraka + aṃ

examples.text: so na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati, hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.
paṭicchādeyyā'ti, imaṃ jānitvā codessanti, sāressanti khuṃsessanti, vambhessanti, maṅkuṃ karissanti n'ārocessāmī'ti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte, āpatti pācittiyassa.
santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kesamuttaṃ āgacchanti. te sakaṃ'y'eva vādaṃ dīpenti jotenti, parappavādaṃ pana khuṃsenti vambhenti paribhavanti omakkhiṃ karonti.

23875.meaning1: wanting to abuse; wishing to insult
23875.commentary: (VINa) khuṃsetu'kāmo vambhetu'kāmo maṅkukattu'kāmo'ti akkositu'kāmo padhaṃsitu'kāmo garahitu'kāmo nittejaṃ kattu'kāmo'ti attho.

examples.text: upasampanno upasampannaṃ khuṃsetu'kāmo vambhetu'kāmo maṅkukattu'kāmo hīnena hīnaṃ vadeti, caṇḍālaṃ venaṃ nesādaṃ rathakāraṃ pukkusaṃ, caṇḍālo'si, veno'si, nesādo'si, rathakāro'si, pukkuso'sī'ti bhaṇati, āpatti vācāya, vācāya pācittiyassa.

23876.commentary: (VINa) khuṃsetu'kāmo vambhetu'kāmo maṅkukattu'kāmo'ti akkositu'kāmo padhaṃsitu'kāmo garahitu'kāmo nittejaṃ kattu'kāmo'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, vekhanaso paribbājako kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃ'y'eva khuṃsento bhagavantaṃ'y'eva vambhento bhagavantaṃ'y'eva vadamāno samaṇo gotamo pāpito bhavissatī'ti

23880.commentary: (NIDD1) khettan'ti sālikhettaṃ vīhikhettaṃ muggakhettaṃ māsakhettaṃ yavakhettaṃ godhumakhettaṃ tilakhettaṃ.

examples.text: iti kho, ānanda, kammaṃ khettaṃ, viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ, taṇhā sneho.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

23881.meaning2: suitable place, place where something is produced or found
23881.commentary: (SNa) viruhan'aṭṭhena taṃ khettaṃ na hoti, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena vatthu na hoti, paccay'aṭṭhena āyatanaṃ na hoti, kāraṇ'aṭṭhena adhikaraṇaṃ na hoti.

examples.text: khettaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. vatthu taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

23882.meaning1: field of kamma; plane of existence
23882.commentary: (SNPa) khettānī'ti āyatanāni vuccanti… kammaṃ khettaṃ, viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ, taṇhā sneho'ti

examples.text: kaṃ khettajinaṃ vadanti buddhā, kusalaṃ kena kathañ'ca paṇḍito'ti. muni nāma kathaṃ pavuccati, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tathattā.

23884.construction:
khetta + kammanta + sāmanta + sabyohāra + ā
khettakammantasāmantasabyohāra + ā
23884.commentary: (ANa) khettakamm'anta-sāmantasabyohāre'ti ye ca attano khettakamm'antānaṃ sāmantā anantarakkhettasāmino, te ca rajjudaṇḍehi bhūmippamāṇaggāhake sabbohāre ca.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ khettakamm'anta-sāmantasabyohārā sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti.

23885.meaning1: cared for by one's neighbouring farmers and business associates

examples.text: tam'enaṃ khettakammanta-sāmantasabyohārā sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti. khettakamm'anta-sāmantasabyohār'ānukampitassa, mahānāma, kulaputtassa vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

23886.meaning1: mass of fields; hoard of land

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṃ nikkhagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dhaññagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ khettagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ vatthugaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ bhariyagaṇānaṃ cayo

23888.commentary: (SNa) evam'etesaṃ khettānaṃ vijitattā vicinitattā vā khettajino nāma hoti, tasmā khettānī'ti imāya gāthāya paṭhamapañhaṃ byākāsi. tattha keci, kammaṃ khettaṃ, viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ, taṇhā sneho'ti vacanato kammāni khettānī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: kaṃ khettajinaṃ vadanti buddhā, kusalaṃ kena kathañ'ca paṇḍito'ti. muni nāma kathaṃ pavuccati, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tathattā.

23889.meaning1: knowing the lay of the land; with a sense of direction

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
khettaṃ nāma yattha pubb'aṇṇaṃ vā apar'aṇṇaṃ vā jāyati. khettaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ khette catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

23891.meaning2: to be likened to a field

23897.commentary: (MNa) khettaṃ nāma yasmiṃ pubb'aṇṇaṃ ruhati. vatthu nāma yasmiṃ apar'aṇṇaṃ ruhati. yattha vā ubhayam'pi ruhati, taṃ khettaṃ. tadatthāya akatabhūmibhāgo vatthu.

examples.text: aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, hatthi-gav'assa-vaḷava-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.

23898.meaning1: accepting fields and plots of land
23898.commentary: (MNa) khettaṃ nāma yasmiṃ pubb'aṇṇaṃ ruhati. vatthu nāma yasmiṃ apar'aṇṇaṃ ruhati. yattha vā ubhayam'pi ruhati, taṃ khettaṃ. tadatthāya akatabhūmibhāgo vatthu.

examples.text: aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, hatthi-gav'assa-vaḷava-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.
